fake_cursor.api_executemany_and_close: FakeCursor records single statements for assertions; tests that need executemany or close use MySQLite or their own double.

mysqlite.api_executemany_and_close: MySQLite's cursor has no close(): the connection owns the in-memory database; no caller needs a cursor close.
mysqlite.update_to_the_same_value_affects_zero_ro: SQLite counts MATCHED rows (1), MySQL counts CHANGED rows (0). Not emulated: code that depends on 'nothing changed' must not be tested against MySQLite.
